summary: Conditional one-shot UI iterator cleanup. Loads the global UI iterator handle dword_7CDE10; when it is non-zero, passes it to UICleanupIterator and returns that function's result, otherwise returns the loaded zero handle unchanged.

local_names.result: current value of the global UI iterator handle dword_7CDE10

operations.description: Load the global UI iterator handle dword_7CDE10 into the result value
If dword_7CDE10 is zero, skip cleanup and return the loaded zero handle directly
When dword_7CDE10 is non-zero, invoke UICleanupIterator(dword_7CDE10) to clean up the active UI iterator and return its result
Return the cleanup result (or the zero handle when no iterator was active)
